question: What disciplined practice over six months leads to freedom from bondage?
premises: Practice is prescribed for six months
The practice involves an ochre or ascetic discipline
The discipline is free from bondage
inference: One who practices this bondage-free ascetic discipline for six months advances toward liberation.
uncertainties: kāṣāyaṃ may refer to an ochre robe or to an ascetic state
plain_english: Whoever practices for six months in that ochre discipline, free from bondage...
